hook: A faster way to pull digits out of pi

beats.say: Robert Smith found a new algorithm to extract hexadecimal digits of pi without computing the digits before them.
It rearranges a series going back to Euler, so terms share one denominator and four remainders can be added and divided once.
Against Huvent's eight-term formula it needs about 61 percent fewer divisions and 38 percent fewer full modular exponentiations.
